correctness.rationale: Direct preservation of multiplication yields the complete unique triple (A,f,lambda) with Gram equation. Zero multiplier yields totally isotropic image, whose ranks and fiber cardinalities follow by a complete subspace/surjection/functionals decomposition. Positive multiplier gives the full-rank orthogonal similitudes; square-multiplier and norm-surjectivity arguments determine the group factor. Isotropic counts are reconstructed by line-flag recurrence; exact leading degrees and the equal-tie constants give the sharp density classification. Standard-group identities are cited. Exhaustive prime and extension-field tests confirm finite instances, but do not substitute for the proof.

value.rationale: A complete natural algebra-endomorphism rank invariant is determined for every nondegenerate type-\([1,n]\) nilpotent evolution algebra over all odd finite fields. It distinguishes Witt type by the largest singular rank and, unusually, exhibits opposite limiting automorphism densities for split and nonsplit dimension-four algebras; these are structural predictions beyond ordinary isomorphism/automorphism-order results. The endomorphism count is neither a mere relabeling of symplectic Lie-algebra results nor just a classical orthogonal-group order: singular operators and their rank increments are essential.
